  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A failure while building the base tree in `seed_git` is caught by the single outer `except` and removes `dest/.git`, so the agent also loses the HEAD-only history it had before this PR.
  WHY: The fallback is broader than the docs promise ("A failed fetch only leaves that branch out"); the reviewers suggest wrapping the base-tree steps in their own try/except that sets base_commit="" and base_state="unresolved". Severity is NIT in the sources; no reviewer disagreed.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3116-3128 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: When `IMPLEMENT_ISOLATED_BASE_BRANCH` is empty or fails the regex or `git check-ref-format`, the block is skipped with no log line.
  WHY: A missing `isolated-base` in the sandbox is then hard to trace, because only the fetch-failure case warns. Severity is NIT in the sources, and the reviewers' confidence ranged from 2 to 4.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:914-958,987-990 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The base-tree path (`seed_git_tree_entries`) enforces a per-file 2 MiB cap but no aggregate file-count or byte cap, unlike the snapshot's 50,000-file / 512 MiB limits.
  WHY: A very large default branch can exhaust runner disk, memory or time on every implement attempt. Severity is NIT in the sources.
- prompts/mode-implement.txt:24-31 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `isolated-base` is the default-branch tip at run start, so `git diff isolated-base -- <path>` also shows the reverse of newer default-branch commits when the branch has moved on, and the prompt gives no caveat.
  WHY: The agent may misread these as its own deletions. The same text is in prompts/_templates/mode-implement.txt. Severity is NIT in the sources.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:1006-1020 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `readonly_allowed` rejects every base blob, `isolated-base` is created pointing at the empty tree.
  WHY: The agent cannot tell an empty base from an all-filtered base, and the prompt's note covers only per-file filtering. Severity is NIT in the source.

- prompts/mode-implement.txt:24-31 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The prompt says to use `git diff isolated-base -- <path>`, but `isolated-base` is the default-branch tip at run start, not the commit the working branch was cut from.
  WHY: When the default branch has moved forward, the diff shows the reverse of its newer commits, and an agent that does not run `git merge-base HEAD isolated-base` first can misread them. The same text is in prompts/_templates/mode-implement.txt and changelog.d/7548-sandbox-default-branch-base.md paragraph 2.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:3116-3119 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When the variable is empty or fails the regex or `git check-ref-format`, the outer `if` is skipped and no log line is emitted.
  WHY: Operators get no signal about why `isolated-base` is missing; only the fetch-failure warning exists.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:1006-1020 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A `CalledProcessError` from any base-tree construction command is caught by the outer try/except and `remove_node(dest / ".git")` removes the entire sandbox git, including HEAD.
  WHY: The four new `subprocess.run(..., check=True)` calls add failure modes that make the agent lose all git context, not just the optional base commit.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:1006-1020 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: When `readonly_allowed` rejects every blob, `base_index_entries` is empty and `isolated-base` points at the empty tree.
  WHY: The agent cannot tell an empty base from an all-filtered base.
- scripts/codex_isolated_workspace.py:914-958 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The base-tree path applies the 2 MiB per-blob cap but no aggregate file-count or byte cap, unlike `snapshot-readonly`'s 50,000-file / 512 MiB cap; the `eligible` list is unbounded and `blob_ids |= base_blob_ids` packs it all.
  WHY: A default branch with very many eligible blobs can exhaust runner disk or memory during `seed_git`.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: implement.yml after line 3128 add an `else` notice (2 lines, risk 1); codex_isolated_workspace.py lines 1006-1020 wrap the base-tree calls in their own try/except (8 lines, risk 3); codex_isolated_workspace.py lines 914-958 stop appending to `eligible` at MAX_READONLY_FILES and log a truncated outcome (5 lines, risk 3).
